Package jsesh.mdc.model Description

A usable model for representing a Manuel de Codage file. The root element for a manuel de codage file is the TopItemList class.

The root of the heritage hierarchy is the ModelElement class. The classes are organized according to the Manuel de codage grammar. This means that classes are grouped at a certain level according to the elements which can contain them.
